title: P-role4: from_role_index 0 entry checked at authorization
description: room-policy-04 §8.1.1 says roles holding canAddParticipant/canOpenJoin MUST have a from_role_index 0 entry. Readings: (a) reject the roles_list; (b) a condition checked when the action is authorized. Chosen: (b), checked in .3.9 authorize, not in validate().
